none: PAS NLM-AD54F0: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II from Muckton
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IAEXERC ITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXERC ITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.3mm, Weight: 1.62gms, die axis: 12
